1935, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 39 Cont.
Agnes Taylor - middle - fears sight failure.
Sep. 17 Albert Rackinger - about 30 - has 1000 cancers, all over face & body. We prayed for him some months ago. His Rev. Brother writes from Ann Arbor that he is nearing death-doors. Oct. 8th comes from Rev. Bro- ther :... A.R. + +Oct 2nd - R.I.P.
Page 40
Sep. 18 Agnes Muszynska - 18 - left convent - rather condition of threatened T.B. caused delay of vocation ...
18 Baby Frances Sophia - 4 mo. - healthy and otherwise promising but crying & no sleep. Enrolled Today (50c) - promising ...
Charles Roemer - 56 - cancer of face
Employment - Simon Beausadeil ... Thomas Robers - 6 - Salvation Army Mrs. Ellen Clarkins - 64 - ungrateful daughter (24)
Page 41 Sep. 19 Mrs. Helen Zakrzewski - 44 - Diabetis, gangreenous foot, last Monday (15) amputated, unconscious mostly since, is enrolled Today at 11:45 in Ser. Mass A. - husband promising weekly Communion instead of every three months ..... and perpetual enrollment.
Mrs. Ellen Clarkin - 64 - ungrateful daughter strikes mother ... no con- fession - mother herself seldom to sacraments.
Nurse Helen Butler - 3244 N-western wants "case" - Euclid 0688-W Olive Mousseau - 23 - T.B. - Essex, Ont. Sister Cecelia - Felecian - that she be appreciative for ... heavenly joys of Mary. & assistant St. Liguori ...
Page 42 Sep. 21 Mrs. Mary McKenna Fam ... Employment etc, etc.
